changelog:
imessage-notify 1.0.0

- Initial release of the iMessage notification skill.
- Send notifications from Mac to iPhone via the Messages app using AppleScript.
- Supports sending text, images, videos, audio, files, and URLs (with link preview).
- Includes easy-to-use CLI scripts for both text and multimedia messages.
- Designed for integration with automated Clawdbot tasks for alerts and notifications.
